questions.q: Lettuce had a "soporific" effect on the bunnies. What does soporific mean?
choices: It makes you hungry
It makes you sleepy
It makes you sneeze
It makes you grow
questions.evidence: I have never felt sleepy after eating lettuces

questions.q: Who did Benjamin Bunny marry when he grew up?
choices: His Cousin Flopsy
Thomasina Tittlemouse
His Cousin Mopsy
Jemima Puddle-Duck

questions.q: What did the bunnies find on the rubbish heap one day?
choices: Lots of fresh carrots
Some overgrown lettuces
A pile of sweet red apples
A sack of new cabbages
questions.evidence: there were a quantity of overgrown lettuces

questions.q: What did Benjamin put over his head before he went to sleep?
choices: An old boot
A paper bag
A big lettuce leaf
A jam pot lid
questions.evidence: put a paper bag over his head to keep off the flies

questions.q: What did Mr. McGregor do after he saw the little ears in the grass?
choices: Ran to the house to fetch his wife
Dropped the rabbits into his sack
Chased the rabbits across the field
Gave the rabbits some fresh lettuces
questions.evidence: as he dropped them into his sack

questions.q: How did Thomasina Tittlemouse help get the bunnies out of the sack?
choices: She nibbled a hole in the sack
She untied the string with her teeth
She called Peter Rabbit to come help
She pushed the sack off the wall
questions.evidence: She nibbled a hole in the bottom corner of the sack.

questions.q: What did the rabbits put into the empty sack?
choices: Stones and sticks from the field
Rotten marrows, a brush and turnips
Lawn mowings and some paper bags
Old boots and some broken jam pots
questions.evidence: three rotten vegetable marrows, an old blacking-brush and two decayed turnips

questions.q: What present did Thomasina Tittlemouse get the next Christmas?
choices: Rabbit-wool for a cloak and mittens
A big basket of fresh lettuces
A new house under the bank
Some tobacco from Mr. McGregor
questions.evidence: Thomasina Tittlemouse got a present of enough rabbit-wool to make herself a cloak

questions.q: What is this story mostly about?
choices: Sleepy bunnies who are caught and then saved
A mouse who builds a new house inside a jam pot
Mr. McGregor buying himself some tobacco
Peter Rabbit growing cabbages in his garden
questions.evidence: The little rabbits were pulled out and pinched to wake them.
